units.source_text: 源氏公子上车，小君坐在后面陪乘，回到了本邸二条院。

en.t: Prince Genji got into the carriage, with Kogimi riding behind him as an attendant, and returned to his main residence at Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 两人谈论昨夜之事，公子说：“你毕竟是个孩子，哪有这种办法！”

en.t: The two talked about what had happened the night before, and the prince said, "After all, you are only a child. What sort of plan was that?"

units.source_text: 又斥责空蝉的狠心，恨恨不已。

en.t: He also blamed Utsusemi for her cruelty, and his resentment would not subside.

units.source_text: 小君觉得对公子不起，默默无言。

en.t: Kogimi felt that he had wronged the prince and remained silently speechless.

units.source_text: 公子又说：“她对我这么深恶痛绝，我自己也讨厌我这个身体了。

en.t: The prince went on, "She loathes me so deeply that I have come to hate this body of mine myself.

units.source_text: 即使疏远我，不肯和我见面，写一封亲切些的回信来总该是可以的吧。

en.t: Even if she keeps her distance from me and refuses to see me, surely she could at least write a somewhat kinder reply.

units.source_text: 我连伊豫介那个老头子也不如了！”

en.t: I am not even the equal of that old man, Iyo no Suke!"
He was deeply dissatisfied with her attitude.

units.source_text: 然而还是把拿来的那件单衫放在自己的衣服底下，然后就寝。

en.t: Even so, he placed the unlined robe he had brought back beneath his own clothes and then went to bed.

units.source_text: 他叫小君睡在身旁，对他说了种种怨恨的话，

en.t: He had Kogimi sleep beside him and poured out all kinds of resentful complaints to him,

units.source_text: 最后板着脸说：“你这个人虽然可爱，但你是那个负心人的兄弟，我怕不能永久照顾你呢！”

en.t: and finally, with a stern face, said, "You are dear to me, but since you are that faithless woman's brother, I fear I cannot look after you forever."

units.source_text: 小君听了自然十分伤心。

en.t: Hearing this, Kogimi was naturally very hurt.

units.source_text: 公子躺了一会，终于不能入睡，便又起身，

en.t: The prince lay down for a while, but in the end he could not sleep, so he got up again,

units.source_text: 教小君取笔砚来，在一张怀纸[\[6\]](#part1332.html#m6)上奋笔疾书，

en.t: told Kogimi to bring brush and inkstone, and wrote rapidly across a sheet of folded paper[\[6\]](#part1332.html#m6),

units.source_text: 不像是有意赠人的样子：

en.t: as though it were not something deliberately composed to send to anyone:
